doc: Earth with a negative rotation period, same seed as earth.seed1.w128: the vortex positions are seed 1's and every omega flips sign (lows turn clockwise in the north), and the wind map flips its zonal sign (climatological_zonal_mps spin). The sign of the period enters nowhere else. Frozen: ascent, back, coverage, fine, high_share, meta.fine_octaves, meta.flow_scalars, meta.hadley_edge_deg, meta.vortex_lat_deg, meta.vortex_lon_deg, s, target_zonal, thr, thr_raw, type, wind. Not frozen here, to stay inside the size budget (a function of frozen fields, or the same stage frozen in earth.seed1.w128 and the other scenarios): back_coarse, lat_back, mid_noise, moisture_noise, offset, s_raw, shield, streak, subtexel, target, weights.closed, weights.open, weights.street. Every field's definition is in params.glossary, the literals of generate.py that no input carries in params.literals, and each tolerance with the largest measured difference it is 10x of in params.tolerance (float32-vs-float64 shadow pipeline and one-ulp nudges of the inputs); target_zonal and the Hadley edge are float64 closed forms. params.plans names the generate() field each recorded draw feeds, params.meta pins the sidecar dict generate() returns.

plans.stage: permutation table of the next note (fbm): moisture_noise: fbm(back, 1.5, 3 octaves)
permutation table of the next note (fbm): mid_noise: fbm(along(p, back, advect_mid), mid_frequency, 2 octaves)
mid_noise: fbm(along(p, back, advect_mid), mid_frequency, 2 octaves)
permutation table of the next note (fbm): fine texture: the generic fBm of regime_texture (regime_texture off: the fine fBm itself)
fine texture: the generic fBm of regime_texture (regime_texture off: the fine fBm itself)
permutation table of the next note (fbm): fine texture: the street fBm of regime_texture
fine texture: the street fBm of regime_texture
permutation table of the next note (fbm): streak: fbm(back, fine ladder, gain 0.7)

params.subtexel: subtexel = subtexel_white / float32(sqrt(max(1, (2 pi radius_km / width / cumulus_cell_km)^2))) when cumulus_cell_km > 0, else absent

literals.bisection: per row, 36 halvings of the bracket [-10, 10] on t (mid = (lo + hi) / 2; the row mean of compose(s, fine, mid + offset) above the target moves lo up, else hi down); the answer is the final (lo + hi) / 2, so an unreachable target ends 10 / 2^36 inside the bound (-10 or +10).
literals.row_sensitivity: max((mean compose at t - e - mean compose at t + e) / (2 e), 0.05), e = GenParams.sensitivity_step, per row, at thr0 (the floor 0.05 stops a saturated row from dividing by zero).
literals.threshold_smoothing: scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter1d(thr, sigma, mode="nearest"), sigma = threshold_smooth_deg / (180 / height) rows, default truncate 4.0 (radius int(4 sigma + 0.5)), on the 1-D row vector
literals.standardization: s = (s_raw - s_raw.mean()) / s_raw.std() over all texels, population std (ddof 0)
literals.fbm_seeds: moisture seed + 1, mid seed + 2, fine (generic fBm) seed + 3, streak seed + 4, street seed + 5, cell edges seed + diameter in km (15, 30, 60, 120); sub-texel white noise default_rng(seed + 7)
literals.back_trace: Flow.backtrace: 48 midpoint steps over time 1 on a min(structure_width, width) x half-width grid of float64 directions, upsample_dirs to the map when that grid is narrower
literals.wind_grid_width: min(2 * structure_width, width) columns, half as many rows (products.wind_map)
literals.itcz: the target and the type and high-share latitudes use the ITCZ shift of the surface terms (0 without)
literals.surface_used: surface terms run when a surface is given AND surface_terms is true AND isotropic is false
literals.extras: type, high_share, wind exist only when generate() is given an extras dict (params.extras)

meta.orientation: north-up, column 0 at longitude -180, east to the right
meta.vortex_fields: meta.flow.vortices[i] = {kind, radius, omega, ascent, age} (the vortex.* inputs) + lon_deg, lat_deg (outputs meta.vortex_lon_deg and meta.vortex_lat_deg)

glossary.back: back[h, w, 3]: unit vector (x to lon 0 lat 0, y to lon +90, z north) of where the air at each texel came from: Flow.backtrace on the min(structure_width, width) grid, upsample_dirs to the map grid when that is narrower (isotropic: the grid itself). Row 0 is north, column 0 is longitude -180.
glossary.ascent: ascent[h, w]: Flow.ascent at the texel's OWN direction (not back): the vortices' ascent field, summed.
glossary.s: s[h, w]: the synoptic field, (s_raw - mean) / std over the whole map (population std, ddof 0).
glossary.fine: fine[h, w]: the fine texture, unit variance: regime_texture (regime-weighted blend of fBm, street fBm and Worley cell edges) or, with regime_texture off, an fBm read advect_fine of the way back.
glossary.target_zonal: target_zonal[h]: climate.target_zonal_coverage at the row latitudes (hadley edge, ITCZ shift), float64, one value per row.
glossary.thr_raw: thr_raw[h]: the per-row threshold t with mean(compose(s, fine, t + offset)) = target, by 36-step bisection on [-10, 10], before smoothing.
glossary.thr: thr[h]: thr_raw smoothed along the rows by gaussian_filter1d (see literals.threshold_smoothing).
glossary.coverage: coverage[h, w]: compose(s, fine, thr[:, None] + offset, params, streak, subtexel) as float32: the generate() return value.
glossary.type: type[h, w]: products.type_map(shield, weights, latitude of each row less the ITCZ shift, hadley), float32 in [0, 1].
glossary.high_share: high_share[h, w]: products.high_share(shield, ascent, latitude less the ITCZ shift, hadley, coverage), float32 in [0, 1].
glossary.wind: wind[h2, w2, 2]: products.wind_map: east/north wind in m/s on the min(2 structure_width, width) grid.
glossary.meta.hadley_edge_deg: meta.hadley_edge_deg[1]: climate.hadley_edge_deg(body) as the meta dict reports it.
glossary.meta.fine_octaves: meta.fine_octaves[1]: the octave count of the fine ladder, octave_ladder(fine_frequency, fmax, top=fine_top)[1].
glossary.meta.flow_scalars: meta.flow_scalars[3]: meta["flow"]["jet"], ["trades"], ["polar_easterlies"] (the Flow the scenario ran with).
glossary.meta.vortex_lon_deg: meta.vortex_lon_deg[n]: degrees(vortex.lon), as meta["flow"]["vortices"] lists them.

back.why: float32 direction grids and a 48-step float64/float32 back-trace: one float32 ulp of a direction is 6e-8 and the trace amplifies it to a few 1e-6

ascent.why: float64 vortex kernels summed in float32 at float32 grid directions

s.why: a float32 sum or standardization of the fields above, which carry their own difference

fine.why: an fBm adds a random offset of up to 256 to a float32 position, where one float32 ulp is 3e-5: any float32 port carries about 1e-4 of noise here (a float64 port is closer, and also passes)

target_zonal.why: a float64 closed form of the rows, evaluated by the same formula: no float32 stage

thr_raw.why: a 36-step bisection of a row mean of compose(): it moves with the fields above, a saturated row sits on its bracket bound exactly, and the 2-degree smoothing mixes neighbouring rows

thr.why: a 36-step bisection of a row mean of compose(): it moves with the fields above, a saturated row sits on its bracket bound exactly, and the 2-degree smoothing mixes neighbouring rows

coverage.why: compose() or a function of it, a float32 composition of the fields above with no hard threshold (the shield ramp is continuous), so the difference stays proportional to theirs

type.why: compose() or a function of it, a float32 composition of the fields above with no hard threshold (the shield ramp is continuous), so the difference stays proportional to theirs

high_share.why: compose() or a function of it, a float32 composition of the fields above with no hard threshold (the shield ramp is continuous), so the difference stays proportional to theirs

wind.why: float64 vortex flow evaluated at float32 grid directions; it scales with the body radius (m/s)

meta.hadley_edge_deg.why: a float64 closed form of the rows, evaluated by the same formula: no float32 stage

meta.vortex_lon_deg.why: a float64 closed form of the rows, evaluated by the same formula: no float32 stage

meta.vortex_lat_deg.why: a float64 closed form of the rows, evaluated by the same formula: no float32 stage
